task.title: Query exact typed workflow-run lifecycle history
task.objective: Complete issues https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/704 and https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/705 by exposing validated revision-ordered semantic workflow-run evidence without leaking private storage payloads or indexes.
acceptance_criteria: Return typed started, advanced, paused, resumed, and cancelled entries in exact one-based revision order.
Translate persisted topology indexes to exact workflow and phase identities while preserving transition, gate, and reason evidence.
Return no history for a missing run and preserve exact evidence after reopen.
Validate the complete stream through the authoritative projector and reject malformed or impossible history without partial results.

attempts.summary: Established RED typed-history coverage before production APIs.
attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow-run target failed because public history entry and event types and WorkflowRunStore::history did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added tests for every supported lifecycle event, exact UTF-8 evidence, missing runs, reopen, corrupt decoding, and impossible lifecycle evidence.

attempts.summary: Implemented one strict semantic history projection.
attempts.diagnostic: Projecting public evidence only after complete authoritative replay kept load, list, and history corruption semantics aligned while hiding storage indexes.
attempts.patch: Added typed lifecycle history values, exact revision projection, semantic workflow and phase identities, ADR-0014, and milestone documentation.

attempts.summary: Closed a fail-closed test gap found by independent review.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found that history rejection relied on indirect coverage for unsupported events and impossible transitions.
attempts.patch: Added direct unsupported-event and impossible-transition history tests, reran the complete gate, and retained a substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review with no actionable comments.

outcome.summary: Callers can inspect exact revision-ordered workflow-run lifecycle evidence through typed semantic values after complete fail-closed validation.

lessons: Public audit evidence should use semantic workflow and phase identities rather than exposing private storage indexes.
A read-only history query must reuse the complete authoritative projector so it cannot return a plausible prefix from corrupt state.
Exact caller reasons and gate acknowledgements remain evidence, not proof that an external condition was evaluated.
Independent review should add direct boundary tests when fail-closed behavior is only indirectly exercised.
History inspection grants no transition, execution, scheduling, provider, tool, or permission authority.
